plugin.name: File Search (Everything)
plugin.description: Find files and folders on this computer instantly with voidtools Everything.
command.search.title: Search Files
command.search.subtitle: Everything
pref.maxResults.title: Maximum results
pref.maxResults.description: Number of files shown for a search (at most 1000).
pref.matchPath.title: Match full path
pref.matchPath.description: Match the search text against the whole path, not just the name.
pref.showInRoot.title: Show files in the main search
pref.showInRoot.description: List up to 5 matching files below apps and commands for searches of 3 or more characters.
pref.hideSystemFiles.title: Hide system files
pref.hideSystemFiles.description: Leave out files in Windows, program data, caches and package folders (node_modules, site-packages, …). When off they are listed after your own files.
pref.extraLowPriorityPaths.title: Low-priority locations
pref.extraLowPriorityPaths.description: Folders listed after your own files, like system files: a full path (D:\VMs) or a folder name matched anywhere (vendor, build).
unavailable.notInstalled: Everything is not installed. Get it from voidtools.com.
view.title: Search Files
view.hint: Type to search files with Everything
view.hintIn: Type to search the files in {{.path}}
context.title: Search This Folder with Everything
context.keywords: find, search, files, everything, 搜索
notRunning.title: Everything is not running
notRunning.subtitle: Press Enter to start Everything
plugin.description.spotlight: Find files and folders on this Mac with Spotlight.
pref.hideSystemFiles.description.spotlig: Leave out files in the system folders (/System, /Library, …), caches, app bundles and package folders (node_modules, site-packages, …). When off they are listed after your own files.
pref.extraLowPriorityPaths.description.s: Folders listed after your own files, like system files: a full path (/Volumes/VMs) or a folder name matched anywhere (vendor, build).
unavailable.notInstalled.spotlight: Spotlight search (mdfind) is not available on this Mac.
view.hint.spotlight: Type to search files with Spotlight
view.noResults.spotlight: No matching files. If you expected some, check that Spotlight indexes the disk (mdutil -s /).
context.keywords.spotlight: find, search, files, spotlight, 搜索
